www-1977238.name: The Ultimate Lasertag Matrix
www-1977238.author: PlasticTopHat
www-1977238.description: UPDATE: No one seems to be playing, so I am not going to bother with installing the elevators. There will be no further updates to this game. Enter into the Ultimate Lasertag Matrix, and test your laser skills against those of the opposite team! Battle it out in the passages, bridges, and chasms, and learn the secrets and tricks. Coming this summer: elevators! I have to save up the gold cubes. Please like if you want more updates! This game includes, for the very first time in Kogama, a fully-developed jail system. In the center of a tall chasm are two buttons, which allow you to control which bridges are on fire. But to reach these bridges, if you dare to try, you must cross the floating tiles. If a tile disappears while you're on it... you go to jail. If one of your teammates lands in jail, you must get them out as quickly as possible, by traveling through the ventilation system, so that the other team doesn't get points for shooting the prisoner down repeatedly.
